title: REQ · Header is a wood bar with brass corners, gold logo, world plaque, status pill with dot and countdown
summary: A loaded round shows logo, plaque, pill with dot, round id, status and countdown on the kit.
description: Context: HeaderOverlay renders plain spans in .sf-frame-bar. Desired behavior: gold logo text, the world title inside a plaque frame (Frame kind plaque), and a pill holding a status dot, the round id and status, then the Countdown, with brass corner decoration. Expected result: visible kit structure with test ids. Why: matches the reference header.
acceptance_criteria: Given a round with status OPEN, when the header renders, then a pill with test id round-pill contains a dot with data-status OPEN, the round id and the status text.
Given a world title, when the header renders, then the title is inside an element with data-frame plaque.
Given a round, when the header renders, then the logo text StoryForge, the header banner with brass corners class, and one timer are present.

in_scope: CSS for logo, pill, dot and brass corners using palette tokens
preserve: existing text StoryForge, round id and status strings

technical_constraints: Tailwind and tokens only; colours from palette tokens.
definition_of_done: Header markup uses Frame plaque and the pill
